scope: Extracted aggregates identify the full private reports/cache records. Fresh sequential process per model/geometry/device; four validation images only; no training or cache work overlaps benchmarks
target_hardware_assumption: Colab-equivalent >=16GB RAM; 120-second target/180-second ceiling per image

training_environment.deterministic_policy: deterministic algorithms; TF32 disabled; seeded RNG

weights.checksum_definition: SHA-256 of sorted weight filename + file SHA-256 pairs

benchmarks.definition: Image read/checksum/decode, normalization, inference, original-coordinate restoration and decision; excludes plotting and initial checkpoint/data validation

evaluation_environment.deterministic_policy: deterministic algorithms; TF32 disabled; seeded RNG

benchmarks.initialization_definition: Checkpoint/data verification, model construction/state loading and device transfer; measured separately before warmup
limitations: Process RSS is cumulative high-water, not model-exclusive memory
Repeated image reads use the operating system cache; not cold disk latency
Same-machine pilot; intended laboratory hardware acceptance remains stakeholder-reviewed
